description: Presidential Secretariat - An Essential Public Service for the Purposes of the Life of the Community
reasoning: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It involves the creation of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for specified services (electricity supply, petroleum distribution, port operations, and transport facilities). This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it establishes legal obligations and regulatory control over these services, rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
